model_identity_note: This native Codex sub-agent was requested with gpt-6-astra. The actual provider-side routing/model identifier is not exposed to the judge and cannot be independently attested. No external model/API/key/Pi was used.
scope: 24 designated shared/HTML PNGs, 12 actual editor downloads, 12 desktop and 12 mobile screenshots, 12 inputs and 12 operation records; plus read-only corroboration of tests/ui/social-platforms.spec.ts. No browser/build/test rerun, no product-code mutation.
observed_successes: All four platforms present; X/Threads header title and menu now share an intact row.
All 36 scene/export PNGs visibly contain the default AI-generated/Fictional disclosure. Read-only pixel sampling additionally confirms A download disclosure band y=92..141.
A bilingual text, emoji and quote are present in every route.
B multilingual body and long token wrap inside the image; all routes contain the single image and two album images.
C complete long body, system state, 12-second voice visual, both transcript lines, link thumbnail/title/subtitle and END marker are present.
The editor screenshots and actual downloads use the same message content and broadly matching React appearance; 390px UI shows platform selection and export controls without horizontal page overflow.

blocking_findings.finding: Both album item captions from input are absent in shared PNG and actual editor download; HTML preserves them. This is output content omission, not a display-tool crop.
blocking_findings.basis: Exact content/media completeness and the broken-export/content-loss blocking gate.
blocking_findings.repair: Render each album item caption in the shared React path and therefore editor/MCP PNG, then rerun B input-to-preview-to-download assertions for caption text as well as image count.

nonblocking_findings.finding: All HTML cases have visibly different header identity, avatars, timestamp placement, composer icons and card/quote containment compared with shared/actual downloads.
nonblocking_findings.repair: Use one rendering structure or map all relevant adapter fields consistently; compare like-for-like widths after unifying the structure.

nonblocking_findings.finding: A actual downloads retain roughly 99–122 logical pixels of empty area below composer whereas A shared composer is at bottom.
nonblocking_findings.repair: Make the scene height and flex/min-height behavior consistent so short conversations anchor composer to the intended scene bottom.

nonblocking_findings.finding: Shared platform subtitle and C link/system secondary text are faint; HTML message metadata is particularly small/faint.
nonblocking_findings.repair: Raise secondary text contrast and choose a legible metadata size; keep the current body text, which is readable.

editing_recovery_evidence.basis: All 12 operation records exist, report errors=[], and pair with matching platform screenshots/download dimensions. Read-only inspection of the generating test shows these records are written only after actual select/edit/undo, saved-local UI status, IndexedDB equality assertion for platform/text/count, reload, download, watermark pixel assertion and mobile overflow assertion. The seed is WeChat before application boot; it does not replace the later platform select/edit operations. No route interception appears in this test.
editing_recovery_evidence.limits: The operation JSON stores action names, not a timestamped assertion trace or raw IndexedDB result. This judge did not independently execute the UI. The score credits the supplied completion evidence and inspected sequential assertions, not an independently repeated run.

not_independently_verified: 696/696 host tests and build/new boundary regression result claims
Full 39-test browser suite, including the reported X/Xiaohongshu selector fix
Independent code review and latest-head CI
Production deployment and production behavior acceptance
Real generation provider availability or successful generation
Real social-platform login, publishing, feed support or API capability
capability_boundary: These artifacts demonstrate synthetic chat/private-message rendering only. Static templates do not demonstrate public feed support or real social APIs. Production, real providers and CI remain separate unverified gates.
